label: Notion MCP (app-owned OAuth)
message: Use an eligible client or explicitly register this app with Notion. The default OAuth capability allows reading and updating accessible workspace content; it is not a provider read-only scope. The broader credential stays host-side. Complete sign-in and any local additional-capability decision, then Load tools and separately grant notion-fetch. Writes, search and agent tools remain denied. No native login is reused, and authentication/inventory is not successful content-read evidence.
